items.name: riyal-price-tag
items.title: Riyal Price Tag
items.description: Styled SAR price label with size and tone variants. Wraps <RiyalPrice> from riyal/react.

items.name: riyal-amount-input
items.title: Riyal Amount Input
items.description: Form-grade SAR input with label, hint, and error states. Uses the masked <RiyalInput mask /> from riyal/react so paste of \"SAR 2,499.99\" or \"٢٤٩٩٫٩٩\" yields a clean number.

items.name: riyal-checkout-summary
items.title: Riyal Checkout Summary
items.description: Receipt-style block with subtotal, discount, shipping, VAT, and grand total. Built on cartTotal from riyal/cart and <RiyalPrice> from riyal/react.
